title: Mediterranean Mushroom Soup
description: A hearty, comforting soup featuring earthy mushrooms and the bright flavors of the Mediterranean.

ingredients.name: mushrooms
ingredients.notes: a mix of cremini and shiitake

instructions: Heat the velvety in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the garlic and onion, sautéing until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 10 minutes.
Add the mediterranean and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the soup and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
